meta.title: Message with an attachment
warnings: resolved: “Vendor A opening the message and downloading the attached PDF through the supplier portal” — switch_portal / vendor_open_event open the supplier portal as the invited QA vendor in a second browser

steps.note: Open the prepared live RFQ summary page.

args.goal: as the buyer, open Messages, attach sample.pdf to a message addressed to Vendor A, send the message, and stop when the sent message visibly shows the attachment

steps.note: Perform the buyer-side message composition, PDF attachment, and send action, which has no dedicated catalog step.
Switch to Vendor A's supplier portal session to inspect the received message.
Open the prepared event in Vendor A's portal overview.

args.need: as Vendor A, open the received message and download the attached PDF

steps.note: The catalog has no vendor messaging or attachment-download action, so tester assistance is required.
Verify that the attached PDF was downloaded during the vendor-side check.
